profile.headline: Backend & Java engineer · Datametica Birds, Pune
profile.summary: I build backend systems in Java, Kotlin and Spring Boot — BI-to-LookML compilers on ANTLR and Apache Calcite, multithreaded LLM agents, and a live multiplayer card-game platform with an actor-per-room engine. I care about clean design, concurrency done right, and tests that actually catch things.

featured.title: whitejack
featured.text: Multiplayer Poker, Hearts & Gin Rummy. Java 17 / Spring Boot WebSockets, actor-per-room engine, LLM-powered bots, 169 tests.

featured.title: BI → LookML compilers
featured.text: Tableau & Power BI to LookML in Java/Groovy (~17K lines): ANTLR grammars, Visitor-based translation into Calcite plans, Neo4j lineage, 150+ Spock tests. Work project at Datametica.

featured.title: Lightweight-Deblur
featured.text: Lightweight UNet in PyTorch for on-device image deblurring, ported to the Galaxy S24 Ultra during my Samsung R&D internship.

experience.role: Member of Technical Staff — Product Team
points: Hardened the BI report pipeline: end-to-end success from 84 → 487 of 672 reports by root-causing failures and fixing two core transformation modules.
Built the Raven BI service end to end: Spring Boot REST API (12 endpoints) on PostgreSQL with a React/TypeScript UI.
Built Tableau and Power BI → LookML compilers (ANTLR, Apache Calcite, Neo4j lineage); migrated 52 enterprise workbooks to 496 LookML artifacts.
Built 3 Kotlin/LangChain4j agents that fan out work over a thread pool with CompletableFuture, and an LLM merge-request review agent for GitLab CI (200+ tests).
Designed and optimized a lightweight UNet for on-device deblurring and ported it to the Galaxy S24 Ultra for real-time validation.
